page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (running side notes, partly illegible); the page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: imbutus, Ducatu Angliae dominus [?] ... Phatillo, qui Hunnos ... fuit. In hac, Hunni bipartito exercitu ... Italiam & Italiam aggressi, Carolus ... Ducibus utrolibet Caroli ... perit fuit, & XM amisere. Carolus ... copiis eosdem aggressus, ... votis, tot-que triduo ... tam victoriae ipsum Francorum animos ... fit, ut praedam ... rent, ac, caeis ... Carolus, palante interutus ad Danubium ... rabonis confluentes ut in fluvium ... locorum inaccessa ... abderent, ... quiae Henrico, Forijulii Duci, ... relictae sunt.

In SCOTIA Solvathiot Donaldus ... qui occupatis omnibus occidentalibus ... Regem fe Aebudarum vocant, & ... cum ... ... Arvenium ... ... pro Cuthi-um Anglicorum, & Dacianum Adulfum. ... rum Praefectos ... cum ... davit. Morsium ... excepit ... Erwini ... qui cum bellum ab Hiberniae inflare intelligens ... & labore & liberalitate ... jam jam stupuerunt, consueverunt.
In POLONIA fuit adhuc Prisymyslus, cuius ... pacificum Leszko.
In BOHEMIA forte fuit Pergamus ... Patriarcha Brithaus P. qui hahuntur ... ... ...

page.notes: Much of the page is faded, stained and show-through; the marginal notes and most of the line endings are illegible, so the transcription is partial and uncertain throughout. Left-margin notes read approximately "Ado Vitae", "Buchan, Ly." and "Ioachimus" (partly); a further note at the foot of the page is illegible.
